superseded_note: This file records the corrective wave, which ran before the complete numbered Contents list was available and could therefore label only 9 rows. It is kept as the historical record of that state; the current mapping is in reports/printed_contents_reconciliation.json.
navigation_note: Every linked row keeps its original heading target; no destination was invented, removed or re-pointed. The printed label is a separate, display-only cell.
front_matter_note: The sidebar front-matter rows are not part of the 502-entry Contents manifest; Accessibility (A1), Brief Contents (iii) and Contents (iv) were labelled directly from the user-supplied list. The list entry "About this Book (FC)" has no corresponding sidebar row in this build, so it is reported rather than invented.
unresolved_reason: The complete numbered Contents list referred to in the brief is not present in this Codex conversation, in the project files, or in the 1,899 legitimate source captures. The printed Contents pages in the supplied source carry no page numbers at all (verified on B2P1-0016.png and B2P1-0017.png), so the remaining labels cannot be derived from any legitimate source.
